Merge 2 source (177 lines; name :2; SKILL_ROOT default `$ARCFORGE_ROOT/skills/arc-observing` at :33). Folds into skills/arc-learning/SKILL.md (currently 88 lines; target ~170).

Relocate observer-daemon.sh + observer-prompt.md + instinct.js → skills/arc-learning/scripts/. observer-daemon.sh derives ARCFORGE_ROOT as ../../../ from its own dir (:24, comment :23) — skills/arc-learning/scripts keeps the same depth so derivation survives; update the :23 comment. instinct.js has no self-path references. Note: tests/skills/test_skill_arc_learning.py:101 asserts skills/arc-learning/scripts/learn.js does NOT exist — relocation is compatible (only learn.js prohibited).
Relocate → skills/arc-learning/tests/run-tests.sh. DAEMON_SCRIPT derivation (:11) is relative (dirname $0/../scripts) so it survives the move; update usage comment :5.
"test:observer-daemon": "bash skills/arc-observing/tests/run-tests.sh" → new path. Fails LOUDLY if missed (npm test breaks) — the one non-silent coupling.

checkDaemon() daemonPath = path.join(__dirname,'../../skills/arc-observing/scripts/observer-daemon.sh') at :81-84, guarded by fs.existsSync (:86) inside try/catch — SILENT failure mode: stale path → existsSync false → daemon simply never starts at SessionStart, no error anywhere.

maybeSpawnDaemon() daemonScript = path.resolve(__dirname,'../../skills/arc-observing/scripts/observer-daemon.sh') at :361-364, then spawn('bash',[daemonScript,'start']) detached inside try/catch — SILENT: spawn of a nonexistent script still returns 'spawned'; daemon never runs.

renderPrompt() promptTemplatePath = path.join(__dirname,'../../../skills/arc-observing/scripts/observer-prompt.md') at :356-359; readFileSync failure throws 'Failed to read observer-prompt.md' — but the caller is the background daemon's curator CLI, so the throw lands in a daemon log, invisible to the user: candidate generation halts silently.

Injected instinct block ends with 'Invoke /arcforge:arc-observing to confirm/contradict these patterns.' — a slash command that stops resolving post-merge (no shims per D1). Reword to /arcforge:arc-learning (or the merged skill's confirm flow). No test pins this literal (verified) — pure silent staleness.

Sibling journaling literal at :244 ('use /arcforge:arc-journaling'). Both slash names survive v5 but the wording items in the decision record attach here.

Generated snapshots (2026-07-02.json, 2026-07-09.json, latest.json + raw/) contain scenario id eval-arc-requesting-review-dispatch-fidelity (33 hits). Sanctioned historical data; latest.json regenerates on the next `arcforge eval benchmark`. Exclude the whole dir from the sweep grep.

R4 behavior for renamed skills: every BACKTICKED `arc-<name>` token in skills/, docs/guide/, agents/, templates/, hooks/ markdown + README.md must resolve to skills/<name>/, hooks/<name>/, or agents/<name>.md; R4_SEVERITY='error' (doc-refs.js:45) so stale backticked old names FAIL `npm run check:docs` the moment the old dirs are deleted. Limits: plain-prose mentions (README bullets, website .js/.jsx, .claude/rules, package.json, tests) are NOT scanned — the WS5 grep gate is the only guard there. R1 similarly catches backticked stale PATHS like `skills/arc-observing/SKILL.md`.

Name-graph sweep checkpoints from the decision record: :62 arc-finishing, :72 arc-looping, :144-163 arc-researching — none are merge-renamed; verify-only that they still name real skills after the sweep (check:docs does not scan .js strings).

grep confirms ZERO references to arc-requesting-review / arc-receiving-review / arc-observing in agents/*.md (including the three arc-auditing-spec-*.md) and templates/*.md — nothing to change for these merges; the decision record's agents/arc-auditing-spec-*.md sweep item concerns other names.

Scenario premise uses `skills/arc-reviewing/SKILL.md` as a FICTIONAL skill; post-merge it becomes a real shipped path, subtly changing the eval's premise. Flag for the eval re-baseline pass (roadmap 10).

Observer-daemon-adjacent hook tests rely on ARCFORGE_OBSERVE_NO_SPAWN=1, not on the skills/arc-observing path literal — they pass either way and thus do NOT protect the daemon path; only the relocated bash suite (test:observer-daemon) and the two silent hook couplings' manual grep do.

! grep -rn 'skills/arc-observing\|skills/arc-requesting-review\|skills/arc-receiving-review' hooks scripts tests package.json --exclude-dir=node_modules && echo WS5-PATHS-CLEAN

npm run build:website && git diff --exit-code website/page/sections.js website/page/hero.js && echo WEBSITE-BUILD-IN-SYNC
risks: hooks/session-tracker/start.js:83 (checkDaemon): stale daemon path is gated by fs.existsSync inside a silent catch — SessionStart simply stops starting the observer daemon forever, zero errors, zero test coverage of the literal path.

hooks/observe/main.js:364 (maybeSpawnDaemon): spawn('bash', [nonexistent], {detached}) still returns 'spawned' and unrefs — lazy daemon start dies silently; observe.test.js only exercises the NO_SPAWN env branch, not path validity.

scripts/lib/learning-curator/batch-assembler.js:358: throws 'Failed to read observer-prompt.md', but the caller is the background daemon's curator CLI — the throw lands in a daemon log; candidate generation halts invisibly while observations keep accumulating.

hooks/session-tracker/inject-context.js:106: injects '/arcforge:arc-observing' advice into every session with active instincts; post-merge the command doesn't resolve (D1: no shims) — user-facing broken guidance, no test pins the literal so nothing fails.

check:docs R4 only scans BACKTICKED arc-<name> tokens in markdown under skills/, docs/guide/, agents/, templates/, hooks/ + README.md — plain-prose mentions (README bullets :166/:167/:175, .claude/rules, CONTRIBUTING.md, website sections.js/jsx, package.json, JS string literals in hooks) all escape it; the WS5 grep gate is the only enforcement for those.

website/page/sections.js is a committed BUILD ARTIFACT (index.html:94 loads .js, not .jsx): editing sections.jsx without `npm run build:website` ships the old skill list live and no test catches it — hence the build+git-diff verify command.
hooks/__tests__/arc-remind.test.js:49 pins the OLD name: renaming the main.js:147 nudge without the test → loud failure (good), but skipping BOTH leaves a permanently green stale nudge (silent).

Relocating observer-daemon.sh anywhere other than skills/<name>/scripts/ (same 3-deep) silently breaks its ARCFORGE_ROOT ../../../ fallback (line 24) — CURATOR_CLI then resolves to a nonexistent path only when ARCFORGE_ROOT env is unset, i.e. exactly in non-plugin/manual invocations.

evals/scenarios/eval-arc-requesting-review-dispatch-fidelity.md Target (line 9) dangles after the dir delete: eval-command.js:338 exits 'skill file not found' only WHEN the eval is run — a dormant break if the eval re-baseline (roadmap 10) is assumed to cover it and doesn't.

tests/skills/test_learning_subsystem_mvp_plan.py:18 asserts 'arc-observing' in docs/plans/learning-subsystem-mvp.md — an over-eager sweep of sanctioned docs/plans breaks pytest; conversely leaving the test codifies the retired split as current.

test_skill_arc_learning.py:101 asserts skills/arc-learning/scripts/learn.js does NOT exist — safe for the planned relocation, but renaming instinct.js/daemon files to 'learn.js' during the merge would trip it.

Plugin cache: per .claude/rules/plugin.md, plugin code is cached by version — the merged skill layout won't propagate to installed sessions until the v5.0.0 version bump; mid-stream testing must use `claude --plugin-dir .`.
